name: imap-plugin
description: Codex-exclusive plugin for generic IMAP mailboxes with read tools and paid mail actions.

interface.shortDescription: Read IMAP mailboxes and enable paid mail actions from Codex beta.
interface.longDescription: Codex-exclusive plugin for connecting generic IMAP mailboxes to Codex. It supports folder listing, message search, message reading, attachment access, and subscriber-controlled SMTP/IMAP mail actions without requiring a provider-specific mail connector. It is not a ChatGPT GPT, hosted mailbox service, or non-Codex assistant integration.
defaultPrompt: Enable SMTP sending for IMAP Mailboxes.
